notes: E5 is not a real problem for this manual, so I kept D8 without an external pull resistor. The parts list, circuit image and schematic show only a pushbutton between D8 and GND. This is the standard wake-up wiring: the sketch's LowPower.attachInterruptWakeup on pin 8 enables the SAMD21's internal pull-up, so D8 does not float. Adding a resistor would break the 'exactly the parts the tutorial says' rule.

The battery's JST PH plug into the board's JST connector is a joined edge between the two parts with no ports named. The electrical edge goes from lipo1 '+' to mkr1 BATT, so the lead/socket compatibility check is not triggered.
The parts are unchanged from step 1. The power source with micro-USB cable is not built, because the circuit images don't show it.

The pushbutton sits across the centre gap in columns 8 and 9. Side 1 (1.l, 1.r) is on the top half at 8t.e and 9t.e. Side 2 (2.l, 2.r) is on the bottom half at 8b.f and 9b.f. The black wire runs from GND to column 8 on the top half, and the yellow wire runs from D8 to column 8 on the bottom half.
